_comment: WC2026 QUARTER-FINAL (QF100: winner of Argentina-Egypt vs winner of Switzerland-Colombia) -- the last QF. KNOCKOUT: no draw -- level after 90' -> extra time -> penalties, so the deliverable is who ADVANCES. Winner meets the England-Norway winner in the semi-finals (M102). Routes: Argentina WON Group J with a PERFECT nine (rating 95) but has had TWO STRAIGHT knockout scares: 3-2 aet vs Cape Verde (a proven block dragged them to extra time) and 3-2 vs Egypt (2-0 DOWN until the 80th before three late goals). The ARGENTINA-SPECIFIC standing note applies: a RELIABLE advancement bet (86-90% priced, always through) but a BAD clean-sheet/controlled-win bet -- organized underdogs have scored TWO on them twice; their games run chaotic and high. Switzerland WON Group B (1-1 Qatar, 4-1 Bosnia, 2-1 Canada; rating 81), beat Algeria 2-0 in the R32 (clean sheet) and survived the R16 0-0 shootout vs Colombia. Organized, balanced, competent -- solid defence, modest attack, NO elite striker -- and now a proven shootout survivor. Class gap ~14 (95 vs 81) -> Argentina a heavy favourite. RULE TENSION resolved: the BTTS rule (clear favourite + no elite striker -> lean No) is MODULATED by the Argentina note (2 direct observations: goals up, clean sheet down) -> Switzerland kept at lambda 0.83 (mild trim only), BTTS near-neutral 50.4% (NOT forced to No), Argentina clean sheet 43.6% (not the 50%+ a naive read would give). Texture: Argentina should win with goals (2-0/2-1/3-1 cluster, Over lean 56.6%) but the Swiss-organized profile is exactly the type that has scored on them -- and if Switzerland drags it deep, they just won a shootout (ET 20.9%, pens 9.6% priced honestly). RECAL: first pass sat 2.7 pts below the market on Argentina (63.4 vs 66.1); applied don't-fade-the-elite, lifted ARG 2.00 -> 2.12 / trimmed SUI 0.85 -> 0.83 to align (66.4 vs 66.1, div 1.0). Home = Argentina (nominal; neutral venue). Cards not modelled (referee TBD).
